gpu.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU
gpu.note: Laptop dGPU shares VRAM with the desktop compositor; load ONE heavy model at a time.

cpu.note: Keep ~4-6 logical CPUs free for the UI, OS and the GPU feeder thread.

memory.note: Only ~16 GB RAM and usually much less is free (browser/IDE/Windows). Treat the budget as a CEILING: at runtime use min(ceiling, available_ram - 2 GB). Stream/chunk long audio.

storage.note: E: is a 100 GB ReFS Dev Drive; use D: (and C: sparingly) for derived data and model caches.
